name: Hosea
summary: A prophet, the son of Beeri, whom the LORD told to marry an unfaithful wife as a picture of Israel turning away from the LORD. His children's names carried God's message, and he was told to love an unfaithful woman again, as the LORD loves Israel.

key_moments.title: Told to Marry Gomer
key_moments.description: The LORD told Hosea to take an unfaithful wife, because the land had turned away from the LORD. Hosea married Gomer, the daughter of Diblaim.

key_moments.title: Names His Children as God Commands
key_moments.description: The LORD named Hosea's children Jezreel, Lo-ruhamah, meaning no more mercy, and Lo-ammi, meaning not My people, as signs to Israel. Yet He promised a day when the living God would call them His sons.

key_moments.title: Told to Love an Adulteress
key_moments.description: The LORD told Hosea to go and love a woman who had been unfaithful, just as the LORD loves Israel though they look to other gods. He bought her for silver and barley and told her to be faithful to him.
